meta.name: release-skills
meta.description: Universal release workflow. Auto-detects version files and changelogs. Supports Node.js, Python, Rust, Claude Plugin, GitHub Releases, annotated tags, historical release backfill, and generic projects. Use when user says "release", "发布", "new version", "bump version", "push", "推送", "release notes", "GitHub Release", or "回填 Release".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检测版本文件并生成发布流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发布新版本都要手动改文件、写更新日志
copy.tagline_en: Automatically detect version files and generate release workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually update version files and changelogs for every release

howto.what: 说一句发布，Claude 会识别项目的版本文件与 CHANGELOG，分析上次 tag 以来的提交，生成多语言更新日志、更新版本号，并创建发布提交与带注释的 tag，确认后还可推送并建 GitHub Release。
howto.when: 当你提到「release」「发布」等关键词，或要做 bump version、推送、写 release notes、回填 Release 时触发。

say.text: 发布新版本，先给我看 --dry-run 预览
say.note: 只预览改动，不实际执行

howto.what_en: Say “release” and Claude detects your version file and changelogs, analyzes commits since the last tag, writes multilingual changelog entries, bumps the version, and creates a release commit plus an annotated tag.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention “release”, “发布”, “new version”, or ask to bump a version, push, write release notes, or backfill a GitHub Release.

say_en.text: Release a new version, but show me a --dry-run first
